title: Compliance runway and gate alignment for SOC2/ISO + SSO audit-log cutover
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an executable milestone runway and gate-alignment plan to deliver SOC2 Type II and ISO evidence for SSO/SAML cutover and audit-log retention/retention-cost optimization. This ticket coordinates product, eng, design, and security to: (1) define deterministic gates and acceptance criteria, (2) automate evidence collection where feasible, (3) sequence rollout with Dedicated/Private onboarding, and (4) minimize customer downtime during SSO migration and audit-log schema changes.
milestones: M1 (2025-03-21): SSO integration smoke in staging - Owner: ENG-Infra (Diego Morales) - Acceptance: SAML metadata ingestion + IdP-initiated login successful against test tenant; Signed assertion verification logs present.

M2 (2025-03-28): Audit log persistence & retention policy implemented - Owner: ENG-Logging - Acceptance: 30/90/365d retention buckets, retention lifecycle job tests pass, cost projection approved by Finance.
M3 (2025-04-04): Evidence automation for SC-1/AC controls - Owner: PM (Asha Patel) + Security - Acceptance: automated proof-of-config scripts for 6 controls producing Confluence-ready artifacts.
M4 (2025-04-11): Canary SSO cutover to subset of customers - Owner: Solutions + Support - Acceptance: <1% auth-error uplift, rollback path validated, oncall runbook ready.
Gate (2025-04-14): Compliance readiness gate - Owner: Head of Security - Acceptance: all objections closed, evidence smoke tests green, canary metrics within SLA thresholds.
evidence_requirements: Authentication: SAML metadata, assertion verification logs, IdP certificate rotation history.
Audit logs: immutable write-path proof, indexed retention tests, access control audit for log reads.
Configuration: KMS key mapping for at-rest encryption, list of roles with admin privileges and change history.
Operational: Runbooks for rollback and incident response, oncall escalation matrix, SLAs for log delivery.
Process: Owner attestations for control coverage and a timestamped evidence bundle suitable for auditors.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Dry-run in dev with synthetic tenants and auditor-facing evidence export (internal only).
Phase 1: Staging validation across 3 regions, include Dedicated simulation with reserved capacity.
Phase 2: Canary cutover (5% of customers) with circuit-breaker and automatic fallback to legacy auth for 30 minutes.
Phase 3: Ramp to 50% with hourly metric checks, finalize retention policy, then global cutover during low-traffic window.
decision_log: 2025-02-18: Decided to prioritize automating evidence for the top 6 SOC2 controls rather than full-suite to reduce audit prep time (PM + Security).
2025-02-25: Chosen retention tiers 30/90/365 to balance audit needs and storage cost; Finance provided cost thresholds for dev/staging/prod tables.
2025-03-01: Feature-flagged SSO cutover chosen to allow immediate rollback and minimize blast radius; rollout to be controlled by Console toggle.
recent_updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting - captured owners and initial artifact list in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ASSURANCE/SSO+and+Audit+Runway
2025-02-20: ENG-49210 created (audit-log schema migration) and PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2431
2025-02-28: Security review prelim notes posted (ticket PM-28114) - action: control mapping to evidence scripts assigned to Security Eng.
2025-03-03: Staging SAML metadata parser fixed (hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth/pull/879) - verified by QA on 2025-03-04.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Audit logs growth increases storage costs > projected threshold. Mitigation: Implement tiered retention and cold-storage archival; Finance approves policy with cap and alerts.
Risk: IdP certificate rotation could cause auth outages. Mitigation: Add automated rotation detection job + canary certificate acceptance path and multi-cert support in metadata.
Risk: Evidence automation false-negatives produce audit gaps. Mitigation: Keep manual verification checklist for final gate and add synthetic audit runs to detect automation regressions.
qa_plan: Create synthetic tenants that exercise all SSO flows (IdP-initiated, SP-initiated, MFA challenge), validate end-to-end with auditors' test cases.
Retention smoke tests: seed logs and verify lifecycle jobs move data between hot/warm/cold buckets at scheduled intervals.
Regression suite: run on every schema or runtime change; block release if critical assertions fail.

2) Security to deliver control-to-evidence mapping doc by 2025-03-14 (Confluence link updated).
